product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code platform that helps enterprises automate and orchestrate business processes by connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.
product_one_liner.notes: The company page describes low-code business-process automation and orchestration connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots; the release announcement identifies its enterprise focus: https://www.bizagi.com/company and https://www.bizagi.com/resources/newsroom/summer-2026-release.

pricing_page.notes: Bizagi has a public page describing consumption-based pricing: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both Unilever International and DHL Group appear on Bizagi's customer case-study page: https://www.bizagi.com/en/customers. | named_customers.0: Unilever International is named on the customer case-study page: https://www.bizagi.com/en/customers. | named_customers.1: DHL Group is named on the customer case-study page: https://www.bizagi.com/en/customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn explicitly lists 201–500 employees, consistent with the company profile's count of 439: https://linkedin.com/company/bizagi and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Bizagi explicitly labels its corporate headquarters Washington DC. Its street address is in Tysons, Virginia; the answer follows the company's stated headquarters-city designation: https://www.bizagi.com/en/bizagi-faqs and https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/offices. | hq_country: The official offices page designates its Washington DC-area office as corporate headquarters, and the matching LinkedIn address explicitly identifies the country as US: https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/offices and https://linkedin.com/company/bizagi.

founded_year.notes: Bizagi's company history explicitly says it was founded in 1989: https://www.bizagi.com/en/about.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index lists business, AI-adoption, automation and product content, without establishing two engineer-authored posts explaining how Bizagi itself is built. An inspected technical-sounding tutorial is attributed to a Product Marketing Director: https://www.bizagi.com/en/blog?page=2 and https://www.bizagi.com/en/blog/how-to-create-robust-apps-bizagi-live-processes. This is an assessment of the visible index, not proof that no technical article exists anywhere.

public_docs.notes: Bizagi has public API documentation and multiple product-help articles, including marketplace integration and AI architecture information: https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/rulesapi/rules_api/api/index.html, https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/connectors-and-widgets-marketplace.htm and https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/bizagi-ai-approach.htm.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists an AI-First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure) opening, whose title contains AI and whose posting has an application link: https://bizagi.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Bizagi_Career_Site/job/Bogota/Fullstack-Developer_JR676-1. This qualifies under the specified title-based rule, although it is not titled ML engineer or data scientist.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT through Microsoft Azure's Private OpenAI service
model_provider.notes: Bizagi's AI documentation explicitly says its automation suite embeds Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service: https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/bizagi-ai-approach.htm. It does not specify a particular GPT version in this passage.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance page names ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR. It explicitly claims ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and independently reviewed HIPAA/HITECH conformity; its GDPR wording concerns features supporting compliance, rather than an independent certification: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance. | compliance_certs.0: Bizagi explicitly claims ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification on https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance page states that independent reviews concluded Bizagi Cloud meets HIPAA/HITECH requirements: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance. This is a conformity claim, not a formal HIPAA certification. | compliance_certs.2: The compliance page explicitly names GDPR and claims features supporting GDPR compliance: https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance. Its wording does not establish independent GDPR certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile explicitly classifies the latest round as PE, rendered as private equity: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw. | funding_date: The funding profile identifies the latest round as September 13, 2017, which becomes 2017-09 in the requested format: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile reports $48 million raised in one round and identifies that round as the September 2017 PE investment, so the single round's amount is $48 million: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw. The company announcement also identifies a $48 million investment: https://www.bizagi.com/en/resources/newsroom/1208-bizagi-receives-48-million-usd-investment-to-fuel-global-growth-plans.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round is September 13, 2017, well before the eighteen-month window beginning in May 2025: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bizagi/__gLrssBoIYRKDIbzRKSDwVcFuvVdYGxKGoreuKlClNCw.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Bizagi has a Business Development Representative—BDR posting with an active application link and sales-opportunity responsibilities: https://bizagi.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Bizagi_Career_Site/job/Business-Development-Representative---BDR_JR693-1.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced its Summer 2026 platform release on July 21, within the six-month window. New real-time Kafka integration is a substantive feature rather than a cosmetic update: https://www.bizagi.com/resources/newsroom/summer-2026-release.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samir Gulati's profile lists his Bizagi Chief Marketing Officer position ending in April 2026, within the preceding twelve months: https://linkedin.com/in/samirgulati.
